title: (Deprecated) Reservation ad reports
content_data:
> **Important**
> To retrieve the reporting data of TopView ads, use the [basic reports](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738864915188737) or [audience reports](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738864928947201) and specify the value `RESERVATION_TOP_VIEW` for the `buying_type` [filter](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1751443975608321). Reservation ad reports are a type of report from which you can get spending and performance data of ads in your **reservation** ad accounts. Currently, to query reservation ads reports, you need to set `service_type` to `RESERVATION` and the only supported `report_type` is `BASIC`. If you want to retrieve the reporting data of reservation ads in your **auction** ad accounts (TikTok Ads Manager accounts), set `service_type` to `AUCTION` and `report_type` to `BASIC `to run a [basic report](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738864915188737). > **Note**
> Running reservation ads reports in CHUNK mode (`query_mode`= `CHUNK`) is not supported. You can only run synchronous basic reports in CHUNK mode. # Supported dimensions See [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1751631253780482) for supported dimensions of reservation ads reports. # Supported metrics See [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1751631257050114) for supported metrics of reservation ads reports. # Supported filters See [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1751631259350017) for supported filters of reservation ads reports. # Lifetime supports Lifetime metrics for reservation ad reports are not available in v1.3. # **Use Cases** **1. Query the total consumption of advertiser in a certain period of time.** **Request Parameters：** ```xcodeblock (code json JSON) { "advertiser_id": 66, "service_type": "RESERVATION", "report_type": "BASIC", "data_level": "RESERVATION_ADVERTISER", "dimensions": [ "advertiser_id" ], "metrics": [ "spend", "impressions" ], "start_date": "2020-10-25", "end_date": "2020-11-23", "page": 1, "page_size": 100 } (/code) ``` **2. Query the daily reporting data of advertiser in a certain period of time.** **Request Parameters：** ```xcodeblock (code json JSON) { "advertiser_id": 66, "service_type": "RESERVATION", "report_type": "BASIC", "data_level": "RESERVATION_ADVERTISER", "dimensions": [ "advertiser_id", "stat_time_day" ], "metrics": [ "spend", "impressions" ], "start_date": "2020-10-25", "end_date": "2020-11-23", "page": 1, "page_size": 100 } (/code) ``` **3. Query the daily reporting data of some Ad Groups within a certain period of time.** **Request Parameters：** ```xcodeblock (code json JSON) { "advertiser_id": 66, "service_type": "RESERVATION", "report_type": "BASIC", "data_level": "RESERVATION_ADGROUP", "dimensions": [ "adgroup_id", "stat_time_day" ], "metrics": [ "spend", "impressions" ], "filtering": [ { "field_name": "adgroup_ids", "filter_type": "IN", "filter_value": "[123, 456]" }, { "field_name": "adgroup_status", "filter_type": "IN", "filter_value": "[\"COMPLETE\", \"DELIVERING\"]" } ], "start_date": "2020-10-25", "end_date": "2020-11-23", "page": 1, "page_size": 100 } (/code) ```
